messages:
Jo Park: Quick update for team - Lattice Health wants to shorten their renewal to 9 months, asks for monthly invoices, and needs their vendor code on the invoice. They also want to preview an Okta SSO appendix in the DocuSign envelope before signing. Redline here: https://docsend.example/lattice-renewal-v1
Evan R.: Can we confirm ARR and the effect of a 6% term concession on the 9mo total? CFO asking for numbers now.
Jo Park: ARR = $150k. 9mo pro-rate = $112,500. With a 6% concession -> total = $105,750 -> monthly ~= $11,750.
Marta L.: Finance: monthly invoices ok. Net45 accepted only if we receive a PO PDF with an exact vendor code and billing entity. Otherwise payment methods are card/wire. Also need to confirm first invoice date for monthly cadence.
Noah S.: Legal: Okta appendix as an exhibit is fine. We can include exhibit in DocuSign and surface it before signature. Will add an SSO contact field and brief attestation. No T&C changes.
Evan R.: 6% concession within approval band for AMs on mid-market, approving on condition they sign this quarter. Marta, ok from finance?
Marta L.: Approved by finance contingent on PO received this week. Please provide PO template so procurement can fill vendor code exactly the way billing expects.
Jo Park: PO template below (sending to customer):
```
PO Number: ________
Purchasing Org: Lattice Health, Inc.
Vendor Code: ________
Billing Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Contract Term: 9 months
Invoice Frequency: Monthly
Payment Terms: Net45 (with PO)
Total Amount: $105,750
Billing Contact: billing@lattice.example
```
Evan R.: I'll update the customer: "We can do 9 months with a 6% concession; monthly invoices available. Net45 accepted with PO + vendor code. We'll send DocuSign with the Okta SSO appendix attached for review prior to signature."
DocuSignBot: Reminder scheduled: follow up in 48h if PO not received.
Jo Park: Customer replied: "Routing PO now, vendor code LH-4432. Please include the appendix in the envelope and confirm invoices will include vendor code." :thumbsup:
Marta L.: Once PO PDF (with LH-4432) AND signed DocuSign received, billing will schedule 9 monthly invoices and attach the PO to the first invoice. CC billing@redwood.example on the envelope.
Noah S.: I'll finalize redline and confirm DocuSign envelope setup. We'll include the exhibit and a checkbox for SSO contact details.
Jo Park: Thanks all 1000 marking as in-flight. Will update when PO + signed envelope received.
DocuSignBot: Thread status -> in_progress. Next reminder in 48h.
